name: IGSet
doc: A grow-only set (G-Set CRDT) supporting monotonic addition and membership query.

members.name: Add
members.doc: Add an item. Returns true if the item was newly admitted.

members.name: Count
members.doc: The number of distinct elements present.

laws.proof: tests/Tests.FSharp/Algebra/GSet.Tests.fs:add is idempotent for a present element
laws.doc: Adding an already-present element does not change the set.

laws.proof: tests/Tests.FSharp/Algebra/GSet.Tests.fs:union is idempotent: union a a = a
tests/Tests.FSharp/Algebra/GSet.Tests.fs:union is commutative: union a b = union b a
tests/Tests.FSharp/Algebra/GSet.Tests.fs:union is associative: union (union a b) c = union a (union b c)
laws.doc: Union(Union(a, b), c) = Union(a, Union(b, c)).
